# Assignments

This page collects my course assignments and related work.

## Class Project — MSBA Course Preference Segmentation

Segmentation analysis of 85 MSBA students' course preferences using MaxDiff survey data. Three methods — K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, and Latent Class MaxDiff — all recover the same three preference groups.

- [Presentation Version](assignment_files/class_project/presentation_version.html) — RevealJS slide deck with animated reveals
- [Report Version](assignment_files/class_project/report_version.html) — Full written report with all methods and output
